summary: Tightened the prose, corrected present-tense framing of concluded teaching, project and expert roles, removed an invented pedagogical claim, and added the omitted impact of the 2025 Meta working paper (European Parliament written question and Italian media coverage).

flags.claim: In his teaching, he offers courses on Generative AI and Media alongside Digital Social Network Analysis
flags.issue: The authoritative biography says his teaching 'has included' these courses; stating he currently offers them asserts a currency the source does not. Revised to 'has included'.

flags.claim: guiding students to critically examine how emerging media technologies and platform mechanics reconfigure modern public discourse
flags.issue: No source describes his pedagogical approach; this is invented embellishment. Removed.

flags.claim: Giglietto's international collaborative research includes recent roles leading Work Package 4 on the Horizon Europe vera.ai project and serving as a partner on PROMPT
flags.issue: Both projects concluded (vera.ai in October 2025, PROMPT in February 2026) per the authoritative biography; the present-tense 'includes' framing blurs that. Revised to past tense with a note that both have concluded.

flags.claim: Beyond academic research, Giglietto contributes to regulatory oversight and enterprise initiatives
flags.issue: The JRC expert-group role is a completed engagement (summary reports delivered in 2026) and the present-tense 'contributes' overstates its currency. Revised to past tense.

The biography omitted the impact of his 2025 Meta working paper, which the authoritative biography states was cited in a written question to the European Commission and received national Italian media coverage. Added a paragraph covering this.

flags.claim: an institutional umbrella framing his ongoing empirical inquiries into platform dynamics, health communication, and election integrity
flags.issue: Vague abstraction ('framing his ongoing empirical inquiries') replaced with the authoritative description of MINE's focus on Italian media coverage and social media's impact on elections, public opinion and health information.
